answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6591 Country: India Title: I want to ask question about growing trend of using commode in toilets these days.Is it allowed for a person in normal health to use commode in toilet instead of taditional seats. I hope my question will be answered as soon as possible. Question: I want to ask question about growing trend of using commode in toilets these days.Is it allowed for a person in normal health to use commode in toilet instead of taditional seats. I hope my question will be answered as soon as possible. Answer ID: 6591 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 959/882=L/1429) As far as I know, in western style toilets, it is extremely difficult to maintain all etiquettes, avoid the splash of water and have complete Taharah; therefore it will be makrooh (undesirable) to use western style toilets. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
